review_level: Fresh PRIMARY screening only; not independent second review, original approval or Pass/Collect
original_unique_math: The three front widths w and full exterior heights H are equal; the shown water heights satisfy hII>hI>hIII>0. For the rectangular vases V=w*d*h. VI=VIII=4 implies dIII/dI=hI/hIII>1. VII/VI=3/4 gives dII/dI=(3/4)*(hI/hII)<3/4<1. Therefore dIII>dI>dII. A alone has this ordering; B has I>III>II, C has I>II>III, D has II>III>I and E has all equal. The source diagram is expressly ordinal: pixel lengths are not exact measurements. Existence for A: w=1, full H=6, water heights (4,5,3), depths (1,3/5,4/3) give volumes (4,3,4) and the shown orders. Thus A is both necessary and feasible. No minimum/maximum is asked.
native_actual_image_inspection: Personally viewed original JPG, formal 768 PNG, old tested PNG and r61 candidate. All three full front rectangles remain equal; the water order II>I>III, gray region membership, Roman labels and all five plan-depth orders remain visible. The source graytone identities were normalized in the already-approved formal image; this task does not change that normalization. Six red strokes lie on existing boundaries, no added region/water surface.
human_semantics: Full exterior heights are the source; E plan depths are the receivers. Same red identifies a comparison of unlike dimension roles, not a numerical equality stipulation. This question asks about water volumes and front/top dimensions, not reproduction of printed ink. Reading a red boundary as physical vessel edging still supplies no new volume or dimension and cannot make E satisfy 4/3/4 at the unchanged water heights. It does not recolor the gray water regions or create paint-count targets. Width, identity and water order remain the governing data.

every_marker_roles.role: front0edge3: full exterior height of I, not its partial water height; first source of the equal-front-height comparison.
front1edge3: full exterior height of II; necessary middle member despite its distinct water level and volume.
front2edge3: full exterior height of III; completes the original three-vase source comparison.
option4vase0edge1: E depth of I, receiver for its full front height; cross-view dimension transfer is the intended false step.
option4vase1edge1: E depth of II, receiver for the middle source; 3 liters is not suppressed.
option4vase2edge1: E depth of III, final receiver; I/III identities are retained rather than swapped.

limits: Primary assessment is not an independent review or a human performance study.
No original control is required or repeated; any two observations establish observed hits only, not causal gain.
Zero-call and fresh-render gates are separate and must pass before copying/testing.
